newsitem.title: USA: Western Digital unveils new products.
newsitem.headline: Western Digital unveils new products.

text.p: Western Digital Corp on Monday unveiled a 4.0 gigabyte computer hard drive and a line 3-inch hard drives for portable computers.

The 4.0 gigabyte drive is the newest product in Western Digital's "Caviar" hard drives. It uses thin film technology and is the first of a new platform of hard drives that have 1.2 to 4.0 gigabytes of storage. The platform will serve 99 percent of the desktop PC market, Wetern Digital said.
Evaluation units and volume production units of the Caviar 4.0 GB hard drive will be available in January 1997. The estimated retail street pricing is $429.95.

In addition, Western Digital introduced the Portfolio family of 3-inch enhanced hard drives for portable computers. Its "form factor" technology allows up to 70 percent more capacity per platter than 2.5-inch drives.

The Portfolio family began shipping in late October with one gigabyte capacity. A 1.4 gigabyte hard drive will be available in the first calendar quarter of 1997. A two platter, 1.6 gigabyte and a two platter, 2.16 gigabyte drive will be available in the second quarter of 1997.
The Portfolio has one of the industry's lowest profiles at 10.5mm high and it weighs just 197 grams.
